Control lamps: - Warning and control lights can indicate anomalies or system activations.
- Red central warning lamp: Stop driving immediately; danger.
- Yellow central warning lamp: Operating fault or low fluid; check soon.
- Symbols include warnings for brake fluid, ESC, ABS, airbag, CO2 concentration, etc.
- Ignoring warnings can result in serious accidents or damage.
- Vehicle may restrict settings if faults are present during ignition.
Instrument cluster: - Displays driving data, range, charge status, and system messages.
- Digital Cockpit offers multiple views: Summary, Basic, Driver Assistants, Navigation.
- Power display shows current power availability and drive/recuperation.
- Color indicators show state-of-charge and limits (yellow, red).
- Head-up-Display (HUD) includes Proximity HUD and AR HUD for real-time info.
- HUD settings configurable in infotainment (brightness, content, positioning).
- Status display shows info such as door/bonnet status, warnings, outside temperature, speed limits.
Drowsiness monitor: - Detects driver fatigue based on behavior above 60 km/h.
- Issues visual and audible warnings at 3 fatigue levels.
- Level 1: Mild warning; consider a break.
- Level 2: Stronger warning; take a break soon.
- Level 3: Serious risk; stop driving immediately.
- Also provides time-based alerts after 4.5h of uninterrupted driving.
- May be limited in poor road/weather conditions, sporty driving, or while towing.
- Can be reset or deactivated in the infotainment system.
Driver attention monitor: - Detects distraction based on vehicle input at speeds >10 km/h.
- Gives staged visual and audio warnings.
- Stage 1: White icon, stop inputs and focus.
- Stage 3: Serious traffic risk; stop immediately.
- May be limited during traffic, distraction, or slow speeds.
- Settings adjustable in infotainment (activation, warning sounds, sensitivity).
Road signs detection system: - Uses front camera to detect speed limits, warning signs, and restrictions.
- Works dynamically; shows current limits and warnings on cockpit and HUD.
- Recognizes additional/temporary signs and displays generic icon.
- No entry detection provides alerts when entering one-way roads or highways.
- Limited in poor visibility, bad weather, or dirty camera.
